name: York University
summary: Toronto university on the Keele, Glendon and Markham campuses, with Lassonde engineering, Schulich business and the bilingual Glendon College.

ib.text: IB Diploma with six passes (three SL and three HL, or two SL and four HL); most programs consider 28 to 30 points, Schulich 36, plus program subjects. Maths AI SL counts only for some programs.

dates.label: Application deadline for international students, fall 2027 (most programs)
Schulich BBA: application deadline, no later applications accepted
Schulich BBA: supplementary application (leadership profile, video, writing)

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A common first year in applied maths, physical sciences, programming and engineering, then civil, computer, electrical, mechanical, mechatronics, software or space engineering. Co-op and project-based learning; first year can be at the Markham campus.
programmes.ib: Chemistry and Physics at SL or HL, and Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL; a minimum 30 points is needed to be considered and to keep the offer.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the IB total; 30 is the minimum to be considered, and the required average is set each year, so competitive offers may need more.

flagshipSource.title: Lassonde Engineering: common first year, seven disciplines, co-op and project-based learning

programmes.name: Business Administration (BBA)
programmes.about: The four-year Bachelor of Business Administration at the Schulich School of Business, with direct entry from school, small tutorials, case-competition preparation and exchanges at 60+ partner schools.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL with a 5, and a minimum 36 points; a supplementary application with a leadership profile, video interview and timed writing is required.
programmes.selectionNote: 36 is the minimum to be considered; the supplementary application (leadership profile, video interview, timed writing) is weighed alongside your grades.

flagshipSource.title: Schulich BBA: direct entry, small tutorials, 60+ exchange partners and case competitions

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Programming, algorithms, data structures and systems taught through hands-on labs, team projects and supervised work experience at the Lassonde School of Engineering, with AI reshaping the field.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL with a 5, and a minimum of 30 points to be considered and to keep the offer.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the IB total; 30 is the minimum to be considered and the required average is set each year.

flagshipSource.title: Lassonde Computer Science: hands-on labs, team projects and supervised work experience

faculties.name: Lassonde School of Engineering
faculties.line: Chemistry, Physics and Maths (not AI SL); a minimum 30 points; Computer Science needs a 5 in Maths.

faculties.name: Schulich School of Business
faculties.line: A minimum 36 points, Maths at 5, and a supplementary application with a video interview; closes earlier than most programs.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health
faculties.line: Kinesiology: Maths (AI SL accepted) and a science, minimum 28 points; Global Health: Diploma at 28, Biology recommended.

faculties.name: School of the Arts, Media, Performance & Design
faculties.line: Cinema, Dance, Design, Music, Visual Arts and Theatre need a supplementary application, such as a portfolio or audition.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education
faculties.line: Concurrent Education needs a supplementary application; Educational Studies asks for a minimum 28 points.

faculties.name: Glendon College
faculties.line: A bilingual campus; some programs run in French, and Glendon's International Studies & Business dual degree has a supplementary application.

notes: York's tuition figures are its own approximate annual costs for 2026-27 and are based on 30 credits (36 for Engineering first year).
IB courses graded 5 or better at Higher Level earn transfer credit, up to 30 credits.
York assesses applications until each program is full, so apply early, which also helps with study permit timing.
